title: Timetables for Sleep
description: Reading train, bus, and transport timetables aloud for sleep. Monotonous data, soothing delivery. The departure board as lullaby.
concept: Real train announcements + train ambiance = the whole video. The voice IS the departure board. Per country, per operator, accurate local style.

structure: 1. Station announcement — 'The next train to arrive at platform X is the HH:MM service to DESTINATION'
2. Departure announcement — 'The HH:MM service to DESTINATION is now ready for departure at platform X'
3. Calling points — 'This train calls at STATION, STATION, STATION...'
4. Delay/update — 'We are sorry to announce a delay of approximately MINUTES minutes'
5. Arrival — 'We are now approaching STATION. Please mind the gap between the train and the platform'

audio_sources.name: Train ambiance
audio_sources.query: train interior rain window wheel rhythm

audio_sources.name: Train announcements (UK)
audio_sources.note: Phil Sayer, Celia Drummond — real UK rail voice

uk.voice_style: Polite, formal, clear. 'The next train to arrive at platform 2 is the 14:35 LNER Azuma service to Edinburgh Waverley'
phrases: The next train to arrive at platform X is the HH:MM service to DESTINATION
We are sorry to announce a delay of approximately MINUTES minutes
Please mind the gap between the train and the platform
uk.ambience: Rain on window, wheel rhythm, distant announcements, platform echo

japan.voice_style: Polite, melodic, formal. Each station has a unique departure melody (hassha merodii)
japan.ambience: Departure melody, platform chime, gentle hum, rain on roof
japan.special: Each station has its own melody — 200+ unique jingles composed by Minoru Mukaiya

germany.voice_style: Efficient, precise, direct. 'Zug nach Berlin Hbf über Hannover Hbf. Abfahrt 14:35, Gleis 7'
phrases: Ihr Zug nach DESTINATION über STOPPERSON fährt heute um HH:MM Uhr von Gleis X ab
germany.ambience: Platform announcement, ICE hum, door chime, station echo

france.voice_style: Elegant, measured. 'Le TGV à destination de Lyon Part-Dieu va partir de la voie 3'
phrases: Le TGV à destination de DESTINATION va partir de la voie X
Voie number X pour le train à destination de DESTINATION
Le départ est prévu à HH:MM
france.ambience: TGV hum, platform announcement, café ambiance

audio_style.narration: Train-announcement-style voice (not reading timetables, making announcements)
audio_style.pacing: Natural announcement pace. Don't slow it down — the announcements ARE the content.
audio_style.visual: Departure board text OR black screen with station name

audio_style.ambient: Train sounds (rain on window, wheel rhythm, distant whistle)
audio_style.pacing: Very slow. Each departure gets 10-15 seconds. Let the numbers breathe.
audio_style.visual: Black screen OR departure board text scrolling slowly

production_notes.data_acquisition: download PDF from nationalrail.co.uk or scrape API
production_notes.visual: black screen with scrolling departure text, OR just black
production_notes.content_per_video: all departures on one route for one day = 8+ hours
